name: rank-list
title: Rank list
description: Put things in order: drag a row, or press Space and use the arrows, with the new position announced and numbers that follow the move.
docs: items are the things to rank (an id, a label and an optional description); value is the ids in rank order and onValueChange reports the whole new order once, when a row is dropped, never during the drag. Each row has a grip for the mouse, a pen and a finger, and answers to the keyboard: Space or Enter picks a row up, Up and Down move it (Home and End go to the ends), Space or Enter drops it and Escape puts it back, with every step announced politely ("Moved to position 2 of 5"). moveButtons adds Move up and Move down buttons to each row, for people and devices that cannot drag. numbered shows each rank in tabular figures and renumbers it live as a row passes. The lifted row gets a fine outline instead of a shadow while the others make room, nothing animates under reduced motion, and a list given a maxHeight scrolls itself while a row is dragged near its edge (so does the page). name sends the ids, in order, with a plain form; messages replaces every sentence.
